limitations: The source is a service-location dataset, not a company, business-name, or licence register. It does not establish legal-entity identity, legal name, trading-name status, entity type, status, or registration date.
SITE_NAME is retained only as a raw identity label, not mapped to entity.legal_name or entity.trading_name, because no documentation establishes either role.

One physical site may produce multiple rows: discovery rows 4–5 share DIS_SITE_CODE A300 and address while CONTRACT_NAME and ESA_CD_1 differ. Records must not be treated as unique locations or entities.

SITE_ADDRESS_LN is mapped as the supplied street-address text only; locality, state, and postcode are separate source fields. Consumers requiring an assembled address must combine observations downstream.
SITE_URL is deliberately unmapped: the available evidence supports a location/provider contact URL, not a website owned by an identified canonical legal entity.
No per-record observation, effective, or current-status date is supplied. observed_at uses only the supplied publication proxy, 2016-05-27T00:00:00, and is not a per-site effective date.
No explicit country field is supplied; address.country is intentionally unmapped rather than inferred.
The postcode operation will emit only preserved valid postcodes. Validator examples "871" and "850" are appropriately quarantined; leading zeroes must not be invented.
No dataset documentation pages were supplied. Header and sample evidence support the direct address mappings; authority and confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
